input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless provision anywhere (searches for "indemnif" and "hold harmless" return nothing; the outline runs from Warranties (Section 9) straight into General Provisions (Section 10)). HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and its software and tools, so we bear uncovered exposure for third-party IP infringement claims arising from HDI's deliverables, HDI's breaches of law, data/Confidential Information incidents caused by HDI, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Per the playbook preferred position, we insert a Vendor indemnity after the warranty section with standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and keep our reciprocal indemnity narrow (limited to the Content and Marks we supply and our own breach of law), with an express survival statement because existing Section 10.7 survival does not reach the new section.

proposal.summary: Insert mutual indemnification section (HDI IP/misconduct indemnity; narrow Company indemnity) after the Warranties section
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity, so we have added HDI's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site and HDI's services, breaches of law, data/Confidential Information incidents caused by HDI and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, together with standard notice, control and cooperation procedure. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately limited to the Content and Marks we supply and our own breach of law; if HDI needs relief, we can discuss customary IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and remedies rather than deleting the indemnity.

ops.text:
9A. Indemnification.

9A.1 HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Site or any services, software, tools, materials or deliverables provided by HDI hereunder infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right (other than Content or Marks provided by the Company); (b) HDI's breach of applicable law, rules or regulations; (c) any unauthorized access to, use or disclosure of Confidential Information, Content or customer or user data caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

9A.2 The Company shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless HDI from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Content or Marks provided by the Company infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; or (b) the Company's breach of applicable law, rules or regulations.

9A.3 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnification is sought, the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that no settlement that imposes any liability or obligation on, or requires any admission by, the indemnified Party shall be made without its prior written consent), and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate in the defense with counsel of its own choosing at its own expense. This Section 9A shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.
